name: FhirHubPatient
title: fhir-hub Patient
description: The demographics a session needs. Only gender and birthDate are read; anything else you send is ignored and never forwarded to Prescriptor or stored.

element.comment: Not read. No name, identifier or address is forwarded to Prescriptor or stored by fhir-hub.

Send the sex when you know it. Sex-specific surveillance checks cannot fire on 'unknown', and the prescriber is not told that they were skipped. 'other' is rejected rather than coerced: it is a different assertion from 'unknown', and there is no upstream value for it.
